e.summary: BNM 保险与 takaful 监管门户：RBC 框架、数字保险/回教保险牌照、ta’awun 互助机制
e.summary_en: BNM insurance and takaful regulatory portal: RBC framework, digital insurer/takaful operator licensing, ta’awun mutual mechanism
e.summary_hk: BNM 保險與 takaful 監管門戶：RBC 框架、數字保險/回教保險牌照、ta’awun 互助機制
e.body: 马来西亚国家银行（Bank Negara Malaysia, BNM）的「Insurance & Takaful」板块（`bnm.gov.my/insurance-takaful`，位于 Rates & Statistics 之下）是**马来西亚保险与回教保险（takaful）的官方监管与数据门户**，涵盖：面向保险人与 takaful 经营者的**风险资本框架（RBC）**、**数字保险人与数字 takaful 经营者的牌照与监管框架**、takaful 中 **ta’awun（互助）**机制的扩大适用及配套意见反馈、医疗与健康保险/takaful 业务、以及保险人与 takaful 经营者—维修商的行业行为准则等。对 RIAA：马来西亚是**全球回教保险（takaful）的中心市场**，而 takaful 是本 wiki 此前完全空白的主题——它的互助（ta’awun）与盈余分配逻辑和传统保险的股东—保户结构有本质差别，是理解亚洲多元保险市场绕不开的一环；监管框架侧可与 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[insurance-governance]] 对照，市场数据侧与本 wiki 的亚洲统计轴（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）补齐东盟；适合作市场分析、监管比较与新兴市场方向。
e.body_en: The "Insurance & Takaful" section of Bank Negara Malaysia (BNM, `bnm.gov.my/insurance-takaful`, filed under Rates & Statistics) is the **official regulatory and data portal for Malaysian insurance and takaful**. It covers the **risk-based capital (RBC) framework** for insurers and takaful operators, the **licensing and regulatory framework for digital insurers and digital takaful operators**, the broader application of **ta’awun** (mutual assistance) in takaful together with the related feedback statement, medical and health insurance/takaful business, and the code of conduct between insurers/takaful operators and repairers. For RIAA: Malaysia is the **global hub of takaful**, a topic this wiki previously left entirely blank — its mutual (ta’awun) logic and surplus-sharing differ fundamentally from the shareholder-policyholder structure of conventional insurance, making it essential to understanding Asia’s plural insurance markets; on the regulatory side compare [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]] and [[insurance-governance]], and on market data it completes ASEAN within this wiki’s Asian statistics axis ([[mas-insurance-statistics]], [[irdai-market-statistics]], [[apra-insurance-statistics]], [[tii-taiwan-insurance]]); suits market analysis, regulatory comparison and emerging-market work.
e.body_hk: 馬來西亞國家銀行（Bank Negara Malaysia, BNM）的「Insurance & Takaful」板塊（`bnm.gov.my/insurance-takaful`，位於 Rates & Statistics 之下）是**馬來西亞保險與回教保險（takaful）的官方監管與數據門戶**，涵蓋：面向保險人與 takaful 經營者的**風險資本框架（RBC）**、**數字保險人與數字 takaful 經營者的牌照與監管框架**、takaful 中 **ta’awun（互助）**機制的擴大適用及配套意見反饋、醫療與健康保險/takaful 業務、以及行業行為準則等。對 RIAA：馬來西亞是**全球回教保險（takaful）的中心市場**，而 takaful 是本 wiki 此前完全空白的主題——它的互助（ta’awun）與盈餘分配邏輯和傳統保險的股東—保戶結構有本質差別，是理解亞洲多元保險市場繞不開的一環；監管框架側可與 [[irdai-sbsr-regulations]]、[[insurance-governance]] 對照，市場數據側與本 wiki 的亞洲統計軸（[[mas-insurance-statistics]]、[[irdai-market-statistics]]、[[apra-insurance-statistics]]、[[tii-taiwan-insurance]]）補齊東盟；適合作市場分析、監管比較與新興市場方向。
